items.title: Build a demand-led kid engagement taxonomy
items.success_signal: A research-only decision pack tests concrete parent-facing category language across 96 frozen exact queries, at least 10 current representative SERP samples, at least 20 inspected ranking pages, modifier demand, current KAL ownership, and evidence/maintenance fit, then recommends the smallest concrete editorial taxonomy candidate supported by current evidence without claiming measured parent comprehension.
items.evidence_classification: Semrush US volume, KD, CPC, and intent are dated TOOL_ESTIMATE evidence. Reused exact KAL-RES-003 rows are same-day TOOL_ESTIMATE evidence and must retain source provenance. Current public SERPs and inspected pages are SOURCE_BACKED. Parent-job hypotheses are RESEARCH_HYPOTHESIS. Taxonomy, overlap, and architecture conclusions are EDITORIAL_JUDGMENT unless numeric overlap is directly observed. Public-safe GSC rows are MEASURED; complete current GSC queries remain UNKNOWN.
items.human_gate: The user explicitly authorized demand-backed taxonomy research on 2026-07-29. This action may recommend parent-facing labels but may not change strategy, navigation, site pages, generators, external accounts, affiliate state, or indexing. It may not invent parent/child use, engagement, enjoyment, safety, learning, or product evidence.
items.observation_window: Research only. Preserve KAL-IMP-001's observation gate. Any taxonomy adoption, navigation change, page creation, consolidation, or KAL-RES-004 implementation requires a separate registered transaction.
items.decision: Test whether parents search by umbrella activities, concrete content types, situations, constraints, interests, or outcomes; distinguish Activities, Games, Arts and Crafts, Science and Building, Pretend and Story, Outdoor and Outings, and Projects or Kits; and decide which labels belong in navigation, SEO clusters, filters, or internal editorial guidance.
items.result: Refreshed 96 exact US queries, sampled 12 explicitly incomplete public SERPs, inspected 23 ranking pages, traced seven parent-job hypotheses, and audited current KAL ownership. The bounded research found no evidence that Make, Create, Explore, and Go Deeper are established parent-facing standards; actual parent comprehension remains UNKNOWN. The concrete editorial candidate is Activities as an umbrella with Games, Arts & Crafts, Science & Building, and Outdoor & Nature as browse categories. Age and moment constraints remain routes or filters; local outings and product guidance remain separate systems. No strategy, navigation, site, generator, page, external-account, indexing, affiliate, parent/child evidence, or deployment path changed. Independent review cycle 1 found two P2 evidence-boundary and ownership-traceability issues; the correction closed both and cycle 2 returned PASS with no P0-P3 findings.
